sources.snippet: AT&T's OTel 2.0 is now live: the largest and best performing open-source model built for telecoms Now live and top of the leaderboard on Open-telco.ai, the new model is a post-trained version of Gemma 4 31B-IT built using 400 billion telecom-specific tokens selected from more than 1 trillion processed tokens.
